evals.name: artifact-tool-maintenance-schedule
evals.prompt: Add a new tool to the Repair Planner agent that sorts the extracted tasks into a maintenance schedule: which ones to do now vs. which can safely wait. It should show up as its own card on the Repair Planner page.
evals.expected_output: A complete, artifact-producing tool wired across all sites: a deterministic camelCase executor + snake_case JSON schema + registry entry in repairTools.js; a new artifacts key, an accumulation branch, and a summarizeToolResult case in repairPlannerAgent.js; a new line in AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS; a new Card-based panel component rendered in RepairPlannerPage.jsx; a unit test in repairPlanner.test.js; and a new row in the docs/repair-planner.md Tools table.
expectations: Adds an exported camelCase executor function to server/src/services/agent/repairTools.js that is deterministic (no Math.random, no Date/clock, no direct network/db calls)
Adds a JSON schema entry to the repairToolSchemas array with a snake_case name and additionalProperties:false
Registers the tool in createToolRegistry mapping the snake_case wire name to the executor
The snake_case wire name (schema/registry) and the camelCase function name refer to the same tool consistently
Adds a new key to the artifacts object in repairPlannerAgent.js and an accumulation branch keyed on the snake_case tool name
Adds a matching case to summarizeToolResult in repairPlannerAgent.js
Adds a step to AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS telling the model when to call the new tool
Adds a Card-based panel component in RepairPlannerPage.jsx AND renders it in the artifacts JSX list reading from artifacts?.<key>
Adds a unit test for the new tool in server/test/repairPlanner.test.js and imports the executor
Adds a row for the new tool in the Tools table of docs/repair-planner.md
Introduces no new npm dependencies

evals.name: nonartifact-tool-total-labor
evals.prompt: I want to add a repair-planner tool that totals up the estimated labor hours for the whole job so the model can factor it into the plan. It's just for the agent to reason about — it does NOT need its own card in the UI.
evals.expected_output: An intermediate (no-artifact) tool: a deterministic executor + schema + registry entry in repairTools.js, an AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS line, a unit test, and a docs row — and correctly NO changes to RepairPlannerPage.jsx and NO artifacts key/accumulation in repairPlannerAgent.js.
expectations: Adds an exported camelCase executor function to server/src/services/agent/repairTools.js that is deterministic
Adds a JSON schema entry to repairToolSchemas with a snake_case name and additionalProperties:false
Registers the tool in createToolRegistry under its snake_case wire name
Does NOT add a UI panel or any edit to client/src/pages/RepairPlannerPage.jsx (the tool is intermediate, so the UI is correctly left untouched)
Does NOT add an artifacts key or accumulation branch in repairPlannerAgent.js (correctly skipped for a non-artifact tool)
Adds a step to AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS so the model actually calls the tool
Adds a unit test for the new tool in server/test/repairPlanner.test.js
Adds a row for the new tool in the Tools table of docs/repair-planner.md
Introduces no new npm dependencies

evals.name: di-tool-torque-lookup
evals.prompt: Add a tool to the repair planner that looks up the torque spec for a part by searching the owner's uploaded manuals and returns the matching snippets. Make sure it stays testable the way the other tools are.
evals.expected_output: A tool that depends on document retrieval and follows the dependency-injection convention: the executor takes a second options arg defaulting to retrieveRelevantChunks, the registry wires { retrieve }, and the test injects a mock retriever. Plus schema, AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS, and docs.
expectations: Adds an exported camelCase executor to repairTools.js whose second argument is an injectable options object defaulting the retriever (e.g. { retrieve = retrieveRelevantChunks } = {})
Does NOT call retrieveRelevantChunks directly inside the executor body bypassing the injected parameter
Adds a JSON schema entry to repairToolSchemas with a snake_case name and additionalProperties:false
Registers the tool in createToolRegistry passing the injected dependency (e.g. (args) => fn(args, { retrieve }))
Adds a unit test in repairPlanner.test.js that injects a mock retriever instead of hitting the real one (mirrors the search_repair_docs test)
The executor returns a plain JSON-serializable object and tolerates missing args without throwing
Adds a step to AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS and a row in the docs/repair-planner.md Tools table
Introduces no new npm dependencies
